summary: This allows users to view the salary template (contract) currently assigned to a specific employee.
steps: Click on the employee's name or ID to "View" their details.
Scroll down to the "Salary Template" section at the bottom.
Click on "Salary Template" to view the assigned template.
business_rules: If no salary template is assigned, this section will be empty.
important_notes: While new templates can technically be added from here, "Assign Salary Template" (HRM module) is preferred as it provides calculation details.
questions: How can I check which salary template is assigned to an employee?
Where do I find an employee's current contract details?
Is there a way to view an employee's salary structure?
